business_route_scoring.not_applicable_reason: M00 owns the immediate safety action or clarification; ordinary specialist processing is halted or suspended.

reference_label_statuses.rule_derived_provisional: Rule-derived candidate label; may be used for development diagnostics but not clinical claims.
reference_label_statuses.professional_review_required: One or more material ambiguities must be reviewed independently by two qualified oral-health professionals.
reference_label_statuses.professionally_reviewed: Two qualified reviewers agree and have signed the label.
reference_label_statuses.adjudicated: A qualified adjudicator resolved a material disagreement.
reference_label_statuses.expert_reference_frozen: Professionally reviewed or adjudicated label frozen for a named evaluation version.

elective_consultation_policy.S0: No current pain, swelling, bleeding, trauma, fever, mucosal breakdown, progressive change or functional abnormality; the request is elective aesthetic or treatment-planning information. Recommend elective professional consultation without imposing a 2-to-7-day deadline.
elective_consultation_policy.N1: A current non-emergency symptom, progressive change, treatment-related abnormality, unresolved health concern or functional effect is present and should be assessed within 2 to 7 days.
elective_consultation_policy.U1: A registered urgent combination supports assessment within 24 hours; a single specialist fact must not be promoted to U1 without the approved M00 combination rule.
elective_consultation_policy.missing_information_rule: If one question would decide between S0 and N1, ask that question or mark the label for professional review; do not silently choose the stricter label for scoring convenience.

treatment_related_pain.required_secondary_logic: If M02 is primary, retain M05 as secondary when the restoration or prior treatment context is material; if M05 is primary, retain M02 when current tooth pain is material.
treatment_related_pain.rationale: Health-first routing and treatment-context routing are both acceptable when the user reports pain after restorative treatment; neither route may assign responsibility.

route_review_queue.reason: Current pain supports M02 health-first routing while the restoration context supports M05.
